leads.Personalized Subject Line: Twist, the Guardian Tournament and Arquinworlds
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi J.S.,

My name is Femi Emmanuel. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Ascent and Peak while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Twist entering the Guardian Tournament in Ascent, where virtual and real blur as he competes against ruling-class children, and in Peak, where he is stranded in the scablands and must find a way to save Canyon City.

Those details gave me an idea for how book-focused website design could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. Arquinworlds carries both the Crimson Dust Cycle and the Keri Chronicles, but the series titles mostly appear only in cover images and a placeholder 'Heading 2' still shows; clear series pages with reading order and buy links could make both worlds easier to explore.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Femi Emmanuel

leads.Personalized Subject Line: Volentus, the vampire pact and the masquerade
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi David,

My name is Femi Emmanuel. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Death or Volentus and Death or Volentus: Macabre Masquerade while researching your work. I was particularly interested in the necromancer forced into a pact with a vampire who will kill him if he betrays them, and in the summit of rulers at a costume ball in the Land of Wilted Roses that turns into a stage for deception.

Those details gave me an idea for how a book trailer could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. The gothic, gaslight atmosphere of a masked ball, the raised dead and a looming threat to the realm could carry a short, moody video that introduces both books together.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Femi Emmanuel
